_comment: Common-use katakana words for the vocabulary module. Session 10 decision (Lloyd): kana-only words enter the vocab queues when EITHER their grammar step is reached OR their katakana-track trigger lesson (kt) is touched — whichever fires first — with the katakana module's CC/SB lessons preferred as triggers. Every word here already appears in a shipped grammar-module example at the step given; nothing is newly authored Japanese. kt is the katakana-module lesson the word appears in, or the first CC lesson after the word becomes readable. Readings are hiragana (ー kept as-is, kids'-material convention) and exist for ruby: a katakana word wears its hiragana reading until the katakana track has walked every character in it.
_status: Readings and glosses are dictionary facts, DERIVED NOT REVIEWED — same standing as word-readings-patch-v1.json.
